eligibility: BURHAN is an early-stage Apache-2.0 verification toolkit for coding agents. It separates Codex execution from acceptance using human-sealed contracts, qualified validators, fresh-workspace verification and tamper-evident local receipts. The repository includes reproducible positive/negative controls and cross-platform CI. External adoption is not yet established; I am applying based on its potential value to maintainers evaluating agent-generated changes.
api_credit_use: Use credits for explicitly triggered contract-draft and validator-adapter evaluations, regression-case generation, and maintainer-assisted PR triage. Model output remains untrusted: deterministic checks and human review decide acceptance. Separate live evaluations from offline CI, set per-run token and spend caps before enabling automation, retain sanitized results, and avoid customer repositories or secrets.
additional_information: The deterministic reference suites are exercised on Linux, macOS and Windows with Node 22/24. The portable CLI checks committed-file contracts; generic external-repository runtime orchestration remains in development. Historical live execution is separate from deterministic fixtures. BURHAN is not a sandbox or formal proof system. No npm downloads or external production adoption are claimed.
